commons.title: CICC CHURCH IN AVARUA, RAROTONGA, COOK ISLANDS.jpg
commons.description: CICC CHURCH IN AVARUA BUILT IN 1853 AND FASHIONED FROM CORAL AND LIMESTONE.  AVARUA IS THE CAPITAL ON RAROTONGA.  CICC STANDS FOR COOK ISLANDS CHRISTIAN CHURCH
commons.editorial_reason: The caption identifies a Cook Islands Christian Church in Avarua, and the visibly distinctive coral-and-limestone church architecture is cultural heritage associated with Cook Islanders Maori.

commons.title: TITIKAVEKA CHURCH, RAROTONGA, COOK ISLANDS.jpg
commons.description:
FIRST CHRISTIAN CHURCH ON THE ISLANDS AND BUILT OF CORAL AND LIMESTONE WITH A CEMENT MADE FROM
LAVA.  ONLY STRUCTURE ON THIS SIDE OF THE ISLAND TO SURVIVE THE HURRICANES AND TSUNAMIS
commons.editorial_reason: The caption identifies a church in Rarotonga and describes its coral-and-limestone construction; the visible church architecture is cultural heritage associated with Cook Islanders Maori.
